t: Russia Ceased Fire for Humanitarian Operation in Alyoshki - Defense Ministry
d: The Russian Armed Forces have established a ceasefire in the Kherson sector to prepare for a humanitarian operation in the area of Alyoshki (Oleshky) in the Kherson Region, the Russian Defense Ministry said.

kb.svo: …He noted that the ceasefire mechanism in Alyoshki could serve as a model for securing similar arrangements in other sectors within the special military operation zone.

t: Trump Doubts Presidential Election in Brazil Fair
d: US President Donald Trump on Monday expressed doubts about the fairness of the presidential election in Brazil, in which the incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won.

t: Bolsonaro, Who Lost Brazilian Presidential Runoff, Drops Demand to ​​Annul Results
d: Right-wing politician Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost the Brazilian presidential runoff this Sunday, has dropped his demand to annul the voting results, the Folha de S.Paulo newspaper reported.

t: Russia Hammers Kiev Drone Plant Producing Long- and Medium-Range UAVs — MoD
d: The Russian armed forces struck an industrial facility in Kiev that manufactures and stores long- and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Tuesday.

t: Russia, Burkina Faso Deepening Nuclear Cooperation - Ambassador
d: Russia and Burkina Faso have been deepening cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy, Russian Ambassador to Burkina Faso Igor Martynov told Sputnik.

t: Zimbabwe Intends to Deepen Cooperation With Russia in Trade, Investment - Foreign Minister
d: Zimbabwe is set to deepen cooperation with Russia in trade and investment, Zimbabwean Foreign Minister Amon Murwira said in an interview with ZBC News.

t: Trade Between Russia, Algeria Up More Than 20% in 2026 - Ambassador
d: Trade between Russia and Algeria has increased by more than 20% since the beginning of 2026, Russian Ambassador to Algeria Alexei Solomatin told Sputnik.

t: African Union Commission Chair Arrives in Moscow for Russia-Africa Summit
d: Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, the chairman of the African Union Commission, arrived in Moscow on Tuesday to participate in the third Russia-Africa summit, a Sputnik correspondent reported.

t: Military Conflicts Could Hurt Republicans in US Midterms - Expert
d: Military conflicts involving the United States could hurt the Republicans in the upcoming midterm elections in November, a former vice president of the Washington-based Eurasia Center, Earl Rasmussen, said.

t: Polls Open in Israel's Parliamentary Elections
d: Polls opened in Israel on Tuesday for the parliamentary elections, with the vote to continue until 10 p.m. local time (20:00 GMT), a Sputnik correspondent reported.

t: Africa Withstands Western Pressure, Maintains Support for Russia — Moscow
d: Africa has withstood Western pressure and has not retreated from its principled position of supporting Russia, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said on Tuesday.

t: Third Russia-Africa Summit to Lead to Major Decisions, Outcomes – Russian Foreign Ministry
d: The third Russia-Africa summit will lead to major decisions and outcomes, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said on Tuesday.

t: Mauritanian President Arrives in Moscow for Russia-Africa Summit
d: President of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania Mohamed Ould Ghazouani arrived in Moscow on Tuesday to take part in the upcoming third Russia-Africa summit, a Sputnik correspondent reported.

t: Office of Finnish President Announce Phone Talks of Leaders of Finland, Norway With Putin
d: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store held a telephone conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin, the office of the Finnish president said on Tuesday.

t: Russia Envisions Africa as Key Pillar of Multipolar World - Lavrov
d: Russia wants Africa to transform into a key pillar of a multipolar world and remains committed to upholding the right of Africans to independently shape their own future, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on Tuesday.

t: Venezuelan Energy Resources Available for South-South Cooperation - Acting President
d: The vast energy resources of Venezuela are available to ensure global energy balance and foster cooperation among countries of the Global South, acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez said on Tuesday.
